title: Direct Marketing Growth Manager
description:
ABOUT LENDABLE

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

- One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

- Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

- Profitable since 2017

- Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

- Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/lendable.co.uk)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

We’re entering a once-in-a-company moment: a major step-change in our D2C marketing investment, a full rebrand of the company and product under the Zable brand, and a marketing function being built out at pace. This is one of the most exciting marketing builds in UK fintech right now, with the financial strength, customer base, and product depth to back it up.

Direct Mail is one of our highest-potential channels and we’re hiring a leader to turn it into a scaled, precise, and defensible growth engine. We’re looking for a Head of Direct Mail to own the channel end-to-end: creative, sends, logistics, offers, and reporting, sourcing the data pipeline and user-data enrichment that let us target the right customer, with the right offer, at the right moment.

You'll lead the channel's dedicated analysts and work with our creative team. Your job is to set the direction: decide who we mail, with what offer and when, commission and challenge the selection and response models, and hold every campaign to CAC and LTV targets.

Standalone direct mail roles with this kind of budget and autonomy are rare. If you've got significant experience in acquisition mail and want to build a channel your own way, at a profitable business with the product range and analytical capabilities to make it work, this is the role.

What we’re looking for:

Essential:

- 5+ years in direct mail, including at least 2-3 years owning an acquisition DM programme end to end: strategy, budget, data, production and results.

- A track record of mailing cold prospects at meaningful scale. You'll be able to talk through the volumes, budgets, response rates and CPAs you've been accountable for.

- Experience procuring data: working with data suppliers on list selection, screening, enrichment and cost.

- Deep knowledge of the DM supply chain: print, lettershop, Royal Mail products (Advertising Mail, Mailmark, partially addressed, door drops) and suppression (MPS, goneaways, deceased).

- A strongly commercial approach. You build the business case, forecast volumes and returns, own the channel P&L, and measure spend on CAC, ROI and payback rather than pieces mailed.

- Strong analytical judgement. You design test cells and holdouts, read results critically, and understand response and propensity modelling well enough to brief analysts, challenge their work and turn it into mailing decisions.

- Experience managing suppliers: tendering, negotiating, setting SLAs and keeping several partners to schedule.

- The ability to run a multi-drop campaign cal

title: Sales recruiter (Contract)
description:
🚀 About WRITER

WRITER is where the world's leading enterprises orchestrate AI-powered work. Our vision is to expand human capacity through superintelligence. And we're proving it's possible - through powerful, trustworthy AI that unites IT and business teams together to unlock enterprise-wide transformation. With WRITER's end-to-end platform, hundreds of companies like Mars, Marriott, Uber, and Vanguard are building and deploying AI agents that are grounded in their company's data and fueled by WRITER's enterprise-grade LLMs. Valued at $1.9B and backed by industry-leading investors including Premji Invest, Radical Ventures, and ICONIQ Growth, WRITER is rapidly cementing its position as the leader in enterprise generative AI.

Founded in 2020 with office hubs in San Francisco, New York City, Seattle, Austin, Chicago, and London, our team thinks big and moves fast, and we're looking for smart, hardworking builders and scalers to join us on our journey to create a better future of work with AI.

📐 About the role

As a go-to-market (GTM) sales recruiter, you'll play a pivotal role in scaling the sales engine that powers WRITER's growth. You'll be responsible for sourcing, screening, and hiring exceptional enterprise and strategic candidates who align with our company values and contribute to our growth objectives. This is a high-impact role - the people you bring in will be the ones closing deals with the world's leading enterprises, expanding our footprint, and helping us cement our position as the leader in enterprise generative AI.

We're growing fast, and our GTM team is at the center of that growth. You'll partner closely with hiring managers across sales to understand their needs, build targeted sourcing strategies, and deliver a seamless candidate experience that makes top talent excited to join WRITER. Your work will directly shape the revenue org that takes our platform to hundreds more companies.

This is a 6-month contract role based in our San Francisco or New York City offices, with the option for a hybrid or remote setup. You’ll report to the VP, talent.

🦸🏻‍♀️ What you'll do

- Proactively source and engage with passive candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, and professional networks to build a steady pipeline of top GTM talent

- Conduct initial phone screens and interviews to assess candidates' qualifications, cultural fit, and alignment with our company values

- Partner closely with hiring managers and stakeholders to understand their hiring needs and provide regular updates on the recruitment process

- Own the full recruitment lifecycle from job posting to offer negotiation, ensuring a seamless and positive candidate experience at every step

- Leverage recruitment metrics and data to optimize the hiring process, identify trends, and make informed decisions that improve quality of hire and time to fill

- Shape and contribute to our employer branding efforts by creating compelling job descriptions, promoting our company culture, and enhancing our presence on social media and job boards

- Drive hiring velocity across a growing sales org, managing multiple open roles simultaneously without compromising on quality

⭐️ What you need

- 5+ years of proven experience in a recruiting role within a fast-paced, tech-driven environment, with a focus on go-to-market functions

- Strong sourcing skills with proficiency in using various sourcing tools and techniques to identify and engage with top talent

- Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to build rapport with candidates and stakeholders alike

- Strong time management and organizational abilities, with a keen attention to detail and the ability to juggle multiple priorities

- A data-driven mindset with the ability to analyze recruitment data and use insights to drive process improvements

- A collaborative nature with a proven ability to work effectively in a team environment and build strong relationships with stakeholders

Our salary ranges are determined by location, level and role. Individual compensation will be determined by experience, skills, and job-related knowledge.

Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.

• Ensure high, sustainable team performance : accelerate experimentation and model deployment without sacrificing quality or team health. 

• Co-create vision and strategy : shape the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Spark, HEX, and the DSA function. Translate strategy into <12-month tactical plans while balancing risks and trade-offs.

title: IT Risk Management Analyst
description:
The IT Risk Management Analyst plays a critical role in ensuring the security, compliance, and resilience of an organization's IT systems and infrastructure. This role involves identifying, assessing, and mitigating potential risks and vulnerabilities that could impact the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of digital assets. The IT Risk Management Analyst collaborates with various teams to implement effective risk management strategies and ensure that the organization maintains a robust and secure IT environment. Essential Duties & Responsibilities:
Risk Assessment:

• Identify and assess potential IT risks, including cybersecurity threats, vulnerabilities, and compliance gaps.

• Conduct risk assessments to evaluate the potential impact and likelihood of identified risks.

• Analyze and interpret data related to IT security incidents, breaches, and vulnerabilities.

Risk Mitigation:

• Develop and implement risk mitigation plans to address identified vulnerabilities and threats.

• Collaborate with IT and security teams to design and implement controls to reduce the organization's exposure to risks.

• Stay up-to-date with emerging security threats and industry best practices to enhance the effectiveness of risk mitigation strategies.

Compliance and Regulation:

• Monitor and ensure compliance with relevant IT regulations, standards, and frameworks (e.g., GDPR, FERPA, FFIEC, HIPAA, NIST, ISO 27001).

• Assist in the development and maintenance of IT policies, procedures, and guidelines to ensure adherence to compliance requirements.

Security Incident Response:

• Participate in incident response activities, providing expertise in analyzing and mitigating security incidents.

• Collaborate with incident response teams to investigate and remediate security breaches or vulnerabilities.

Risk Reporting and Communication:

• Prepare and present reports on IT risks, vulnerabilities, and mitigation efforts to management and relevant stakeholders.

• Communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences effectively.

Security Awareness and Training:

• Assist in developing and delivering IT security awareness programs to educate employees about security best practices.

• Provide guidance and training to employees regarding risk management procedures and policies.

Continuous Improvement:

• Identify areas for process improvements and recommend solutions to enhance the overall IT risk management program.

• Participate in the evaluation and implementation of new technologies and tools to enhance risk assessment and mitigation capabilities.

Job Skills:

• Understanding of IT risk management principles, cybersecurity concepts, and industry standards.

• Proficiency in risk assessment methodologies, vulnerability assessment tools, and security frameworks.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess complex situations and provide practical solutions.

• Effective communication skills to convey technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Collaborative attitude with the ability to work across different teams and departments.

• Experience with security incident response and familiarity with security tools and technologies.

Work Experience:

• 3 to 5 years in a similar role.

Education:

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business, or a related field required.

Certificates, licenses and registrations:

• Preference: Professional certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC) Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), or Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) are advantageous.

title: Tech Lead / CTO (m/w/d)
description:
THE OPPORTUNITY

Tax advisory has everything automation needs: structured data, recurring work, clear rules. Yet the profession never made the leap, because recurring does not mean uniform - every case has its own twist, and the law keeps moving. Reasoning resolves exactly this variance. That is why the window is open now. At the same time the market is being reordered: four in ten tax advisors in Germany leave the profession within ten years, and many of their firms will find no successor.

Vogel acquires established advisory firms and develops them further. Several thousand mid-sized companies trust us with their tax, accounting and strategic matters, and every acquisition adds to that base. We have already produced our own annual financial statements with AI. Today, that is one person with a tool. Turning it into a capability of the whole company is the job.

You own the technology that makes Vogel AI-first: the data layer above DATEV, the agent infrastructure on top, and the control layer without which nothing in this profession may go live. You decide the architecture and the stack of what we build. You report to and work directly with Moritz Vogel. Decisions are made in minutes, not months.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Architecture above DATEV

- Build the data layer above DATEV. DATEV stays the system of record (for now); the value is created in the layer above it - designed to outlive the system beneath.

- Choose and build the agent infrastructure: framework, orchestration, versioning, observability. You answer these questions with code, not with a slide deck.

- Make integration a capability, not a project: every client brings their own upstream systems, and today each connection is built by hand. Build the layer those systems plug into, so what makes a client different arrives as context the agents read - never as custom code. One more client must never mean one more integration project.

Reproducibility and control

- A tax advisor must get the same result twice, and an auditor must be able to trace it. Probabilistic where there is variance, deterministic where there are numbers.

- Build the control layer so that a certified professional sees within seconds what an agent did - version, source, decision - and can sign off on it.

- Build evaluation on what no newcomer has: decades of audited, completed work.

Team and scale

- Make the architecture calls: design, stack, build or buy for the layer. Nobody has decided it for you, and nobody will overrule it by committee.

- Hire and lead the engineering team. The budget for your first engineers is approved - you start hiring in your first quarter.

- Make every acquired firm land on the same base, so technology scales with every acquisition. And stay in the code: you commit and you review.

OPEN QUESTIONS - YOURS TO ANSWER

- Where exactly does probabilistic end and deterministic begin?

- How does a system learn from closed cases without losing its reproducibility?

- A new client arrives with their own systems. What may change in the system, and what may not?

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- 6 months: Architecture decided. One real use case from the core business runs in production and is used daily. Your first engineers are hired.

- 12 months: Several agentic use cases in regular operation. The control layer holds up in a real review, and evaluation runs against closed cases, not test data.

- 24 months: Automation is a capability of the organization, not of individuals. Every acquired firm runs on the same base, and your team ships without you in the room.

Where it leads: the full CTO mandate - a management career earned by contribution, not by years served.

WHAT YOU BRING

- You have built something that ran in production and was used by people who did not build it - as founding engineer, engineering lead, technical co-founder or in a comparable role.

- You have taken agentic systems into production and know where they break.

- You have integrated against systems that fight

title: CENTRALE LYON - Post-doctoral researcher (12 months) Mathematics of energy-efficient AI: diffusion models on emerging hardware
description: The question Generating one image with a diffusion model means evaluating a large neural network tens to hundreds of times. That repetition is where the energy goes, and it is part of why data-centre demand is now visible at grid scale: the Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory puts US data-centre electricity use at 176 TWh in 2023, 4.4 % of national consumption, a figure that more than doubled since 2017 largely because of AI servers, and projects 325-580 TWh by 2028. Emerging hardware attacks exactly this primitive: analog in-memory computing, silicon photonics, ferroelectric devices and stochastic computing perform the underlying matrix-vector products at lower energy than digital CMOS, under conditions on scale and precision, but return a perturbed result. The usual objection is that nobody can say in advance how much perturbation a model tolerates. In EMMA, this opportunity is pursued through a PCM-based photonic matrix-vector engine as the primary demonstrator, complemented where appropriate by FeFET-based analog computing, so that device-level non-idealities are treated as explicit design parameters rather than as after-the-fact implementation losses. Diffusion models are an unusual case in which that question has a mathematical answer: their convergence theory bounds the discrepancy between the generated and target distributions by three terms, of which only one, the L 2 error of the learned score, depends on the hardware. That side is now in good shape: for stochastic samplers, bounds linear in the dimension under minimal assumptions on the data; for deterministic samplers, a matching theory under regularity. What is missing is the bridge. The theory is parameterised by a score error, the hardware literature by conductance noise, effective number of bits and photons per multiply-accumulate; nobody has written the map between them, in either direction. description:

ADHDAdvisor.org is on a mission to remove the conventional barriers to ADHD diagnosis and treatment and make mental health care more accessible to everyone, no matter where they live. What are we looking for?

title: Staff Software Engineer, Docker AI Substrate (Seattle or Palo Alto)
locationText: Palo Alto, CA or Seattle, WA
description:
ABOUT DOCKER

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

As agents take on bigger jobs, the infrastructure around them matters more. Docker's answer is to give every agent a strong boundary, make its environment and authority reproducible, and let the work run where it makes sense, from a developer's laptop to the cloud. The Docker AI Substrate team brings that foundation to the enterprise: the largest companies in the world, running agents at scale, with the security, reliability, and control they expect from any critical system. We are a small, senior team at the start of that work. As a Staff Software Engineer here, you will shape the architecture, build the core systems, and run what you build.

Locations: Seattle, WA or Palo Alto, CA.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Design and build the systems that deploy, release, and operate Docker's agentic platform for enterprise customers, in Go and on Kubernetes.

- Make the platform run consistently across cloud providers and environments, with the security, identity, and network boundaries enterprises require.

- Own the release and supply chain path so every deployment is reproducible, verifiable, and trusted.

- Run what you build: production ownership, on-call, SLOs, incident response, and the operational tooling that keeps it boring.

- Set technical direction with the team's architect and engineering leadership, and work with partner teams across runtime, developer experience, identity, and observability.

- Raise the bar through design review, testing discipline, and mentorship as the team grows.

QUALIFICATIONS

REQUIRED

- You have built and operated a cloud control and management plane. Software that provisions, upgrades, and watches infrastructure for many tenants or environments, in production, with a pager. Experience at a cloud provider, a managed-service vendor, or a platform team that stamps out environments.

- Kubernetes beyond deployment. You have written controllers or operators, understand reconciliation and CRDs, and know why declarative beats imperative at fleet scale.

- Deep in at least one major cloud. Hands-on with compute, networking, identity, and managed services, and able to pick up a second cloud fast.

- Production ownership. On-call, incident response, SLOs, post-mortems. You run what you build.

- Distributed systems design. Fault tolerance, consistency, observability, idempotent reconciliation.

- Go. Professional proficiency. Docker's backend and all of this team's code is Go.

- 10+ years of professional software engineering in infrastructure, platform, or cloud services, with the judgment to set direction for others.

STRONGLY PREFERRED

- Kubernetes resource orchestration and cloud controllers, such as KRO.

- Release engineering and software supply chain: OCI registries, digests, license compliance.

- Private connectivity between cloud accounts: PrivateLink, VPC peering, service endpoints, egress policy.

- OpenTelemetry pipelines with multiple destinations.

- Building managed services.

- Firecracker, microVMs, or other isolated execution environments for untrusted code.

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Docker considers visa sponsorship on a case-by-case basis base

title: Senior Medical Science Liaison (Neurology); West Region
description:
About Us

We are developing potentially best-in-class therapies for patients living with severe autoimmune diseases. Our lead antibody, claseprubart (DNTH103), is purposefully engineered with extended half-life, improved potency, and high selectivity for only the active C1s complement protein that drives disease pathology - enabling less frequent and more convenient self-administered subcutaneous injections. Our second clinical candidate, DNTH212 is a first and potentially best in class, bifunctional inhibitor that targets clinically validated and complementary disease modifying mechanisms, Type 1 IFN suppression and B cell modulation - enabling potential for improved clinical outcomes and patient friendly convenient, self-administered subcutaneous injections. Our newest candidate, DNTH312, is an internally developed, investigational, first-in-class, next-generation bifunctional fusion protein combining claseprubart and TACI to target potent inhibition of aC1s and BAFF/APRIL. Verve Retail Media (VRM) solves this problem. We market and operate digital advertising screens across several thousand grocery, drugstore and convenience store locations, connecting them with digital coupons and retargeting campaigns on connected TV (CTV) and other offsite channels.

Role Overview

We are looking for an Desktop Support to provide reliable and professional technical support to end users in a fast-paced corporate environment.

The role will primarily focus on Level 1 desktop and end-user support, covering hardware, operating systems, applications, connectivity, user access, and workplace technology. The position will support a mixed technology environment, including macOS and Windows devices, while working closely with Level 2 and specialist IT teams when required.

The successful candidate will combine strong technical troubleshooting skills with a customer-focused approach, ensuring that users receive an efficient and professional IT support experience.

 

Key Responsibilities

Provide Level 1 technical support through service desk, phone, email, chat, and in-person channels.

Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, operating system, software, connectivity, peripheral, and user access issues across macOS and Windows environments.

Configure, deploy, maintain, and replace laptops, desktops, monitors, printers, mobile devices, and other IT equipment.

Support common business applications, including Microsoft 365, collaboration tools, browsers, VPN clients, and creative applications.

Troubleshoot Wi-Fi, VPN, basic network connectivity, authentication, MFA, and account-related issues.

Manage incidents and service requests through the organization's ITSM / ticketing platform, documenting troubleshooting and resolutions accurately.

•
Escalate more complex issues to Level 2 or specialist teams with appropriate diagnostic information.

•
Support employee onboarding and offboarding, including device preparation, equipment allocation, collection, and access-related requests.

•
Assist with device management, software deployments, operating system updates, security policies, and IT asset management.

•
Provide support for meeting rooms, video conferencing, presentation equipment, and other workplace technologies.

•
Contribute to IT projects, hardware refreshes, technology rollouts, and continuous improvement initiatives.

•
Maintain a high level of customer service and ensure issues are handled professionally and within agreed service levels.

Required Skills & Experience

•
Previous experience in IT support, desktop support, service desk, or a similar IT role.

•
Good practical knowledge of macOS and Windows operating systems and common desktop troubleshooting techniques.

•
Experience supporting laptops, desktops, mobile devices, printers, monitors, docking stations, and other IT peripherals.

•
Familiarity with common business applications, particularly Microsoft 365 and collaboration tools.

•
Basic understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, and VPN troubleshooting.

•
Familiarity with user account, authentication, MFA, and access management.

•
Experience working with an ITSM / ticketing system and understanding of incident and service request management

title: Psicólogos
description:
¿Quiénes somos?

Somos el proveedor líder en beneficios de salud mental para colaboradores, brindando servicio a más de 17 millones de personas en todo el mundo y cubriendo 585, 000 vidas en Latinoamérica. Lyra Health está transformando el acceso a una atención de salud mental que cambia vidas.

Lyra es una empresa reconocida a nivel internacional que brinda Programas de Apoyo al Empleado (PAE) a organizaciones en distintos países. Nuestro objetivo es promover el bienestar emocional de los colaboradores y sus familias a través de servicios. 

Nuestra Cultura y Valores

En Lyra transformamos el acceso a atención de salud mental que cambia vidas… comprometidos en el día a día con nuestros valores globales; Poner al cliente primero, Seguir la evidencia científica, Ser transparente, Escuchar con atención, Mirar hacia adentro, Enfrentar los retos y Cuidar de ti mismo.

¿En qué consiste? 

Buscamos psicólogos que deseen integrarse a nuestra red profesional para brindar atención presencial bajo un modelo de intervención breve. 
Los colaboradores de empresas afiliadas, así como sus familiares directos, acceden a nuestro Call Center en México (operado por psicólogos). Tras una evaluación inicial, los casos pueden ser referidos a sesiones presenciales.
El número de sesiones por caso varía, dependiendo del contrato establecido por la empresa. 

Principales características del programa:

* Servicio totalmente confidencial 
* No se requiere exclusividad de horario
* No se garantiza número fijo de clientes 
* Pago por transferencia electrónica bancaria al cierre del caso

Extendemos de manera gratuita para nuestros afiliados y sus familiares directos los servicios telefónicos que suministran: 

* Orientación Legal
* Orientación Alimentaria
* Orientación Financiera
* Asesoría emocional
* Información del día a día
 
Nuestro compromiso

Buscamos construir una red profesional sólida, colaborativa y de beneficio mutuo. No sólo solicitamos tu participación eventual en nuestros servicios, también queremos ser un respaldo para ti. 
Si deseas formar parte de una red internacional comprometida con el bienestar emocional, te identificas con este perfil y quieres impactar en la vida de las personas, postúlate y te contactaremos tan pronto como sea posible.

title: Quality Engineering Lead / Automation Architect
description:

POMS develops Manufacturing Execution System (MES) software solutions for the life sciences industry. POMS is investing heavily in automated quality engineering, modern software delivery practices, and AI-assisted testing to further product quality and accelerate delivery.

Position Summary
POMS is seeking a hands-on Quality Engineering Lead / Automation Architect to lead the shift from predominantly manual testing to automation-driven quality engineering. This is a hands-on role: the successful candidate will personally help enhance the automation foundation (Playwright framework, standards, and CI/CD integration) and lead a global QA team to deliver automation at scale, using data to measure outcomes and prioritize investments.

Automation Strategy and Architecture

• Own POMS' test automation strategy and roadmap, serving as technical lead for the Playwright framework, automation standards, coding guidelines, and review practices.

• Design and build scalable Playwright suites in TypeScript, making effective use of fixtures, workers, parallelization, test isolation, retries, traces, and reporting.

• Organize workflow-based testing suites with clear smoke, core regression, and release regression layers across functional, API, integration, and end-to-end testing.

• Assess the existing manual test inventory and prioritize which tests should be automated, redesigned, consolidated, kept manual, or retired

• Set goals, performance expectations, and career development plans, and support hiring, onboarding, and succession planning.

• Foster quality ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Quality and Release Management

• Build operational and executive dashboards and KPIs covering automation coverage, defect escape rates, release readiness, and team performance, and use them to prioritize investments.

• Experience scaling automation capability through coaching, standards, and delegation.

• Proven use of quality metrics, dashboards, and KPIs to drive decisions and outcomes.

• Experience testing complex web-based enterprise applications in Agile environments.

• Mentor junior team members and support knowledge transfer across the security team.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Deep experience operating SAP GRC Access Control (ARA, ARM, BRM, EAM).

• Hands-on experience securing Fiori, BTP, and cloud SAP applications.

• Familiarity with SAP IDM or third-party IGA tooling.

• Working knowledge of SAP Process Control.

• Strong understanding of regulatory frameworks such as SOX, GxP, and PCI.

• Excellent communication and documentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• SAP-certified Security or GRC credentials.

• Experience with SAP Cloud Identity services (IAS, IPS) and SCIM-based integrations.

At Boldin , we believe financial confidence should be accessible to everyone. Money decisions shape our lives, yet too often people are left without the clarity or tools they need to make informed choices. We exist to change that.

With over $20M raised and strong momentum, Boldin is entering a pivotal phase of growth. This is an opportunity to join a mission-driven team and help shape the future.

We're looking for a Senior Performance Marketing Manager to own paid user acquisition end to end.
You'll own the paid budget, the channel mix, and the number. Today, that means search and paid social do the heavy lifting; from there, you'll decide where we expand next-CTV, podcast, and paid sponsorships, or somewhere we haven't tried yet. You'll make that call based on what the data says, not what's fashionable.
This is a hands-on role with real scope. You'll be in the accounts, writing copy, setting up landing page tests, reporting out on the numbers, and hitting our CAC targets. You'll work directly with our Head of Growth, and closely with data, product, lifecycle, and creative partners. If you like to be hands-on while driving the strategy, this is a good fit.
Key Responsibilities

• Own paid acquisition strategy and execution across all paid channels, with an initial focus on SEM and paid social, then expanding into CTV, paid sponsorships, and new channels as the data supports it.

• Own the paid media budget: allocation across channels, pacing, and reallocation away from non efficient spend toward what's working

• Run end-to-end campaign management-strategy, build, launch, optimization, analysis, and reporting

• Partner with product and design to improve landing page and funnel conversion rates, bringing specific recommendations rather than general feedback

• Manage performance against efficiency targets (CAC, LTV:CAC, CPA, ROAS) rather than top-of-funnel volume alone, and connect paid spend to registrations, trial starts, and new customer revenue.

• Analyze audience and placement data to find new opportunities and cut inefficient segments

• Report on paid performance and test results weekly, and translate results into a clear point of view on what we do next

• Partner with our data team to make sure attribution, tracking, and conversion measurement are trustworthy-and flag it loudly when they aren't

• Evaluate and manage agencies, vendors, and tools where they extend our capacity

• Evolve the acquisition roadmap based on performance, seasonality, competitive shifts, and new audience insight

Requirements

• 6+ years in performance marketing or paid acquisition, with meaningful time in a consumer/B2C environment

• Hands-on operator experience in Google Ads and paid social (Meta at minimum; Reddit, LinkedIn, YouTube, or TikTok a plus)-you've built and optimized accounts yourself, not just briefed an agency

• Track record of owning a paid budget of at least $1M annually and hitting efficiency targets, with specific numbers you can walk through

• Strong analytical skills: comfortable pulling your own numbers from BI or warehouse layer, and able to build your own reporting rather than waiting on someone else

• Working understanding of attribution, incrementality, and measurement limitations-you know when a number is directional vs. reliable

• Experience with subscription or freemium business models, and comfort optimizing to downstream revenue rather than lead volume

To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. Snowflake's Content Marketing team is evolving into a Content Center of Excellence (CoE) that earns market authority through deep topic ownership, original research, and AI-powered workflows. We are looking for a Content Marketing Manager who will sit at the intersection of thought leadership, research, and AI innovation - someone who doesn't just write great content but builds the systems and AI workflows that scale great content across Snowflake.

This role is strategic and hands-on. You will drive original research initiatives, develop thought leadership narratives on priority topics, and architect AI-driven content workflows. You will also serve as an evangelist for the CoE's best practices, extending AI-powered content creation capabilities to product marketing, field marketing, and GTM teams across the company.

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

You'll architect distributed payment systems at global scale, designing and evolving core infrastructure across real-time local clearing, SWIFT, and proprietary treasury routing in 150+ countries.

- Architect distributed payment systems at global scale, designing and evolving core infrastructure across real-time local clearing, SWIFT, and proprietary treasury routing in 150+ countries.

- Solve complex financial integrity problems by building idempotent, fault-tolerant systems for multi-currency reconciliation, asynchronous settlement, and compensation logic across unreliable banking partners.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Essentials

- 7+ years’ experience building and operating production software, including distributed systems at scale.

- Strong system architecture skills, with practical experience designing for fault tolerance, idempotency, asynchronous workflows, reconciliation, settlement, and failure recovery.

- Experience owning reliability for critical systems, including defining SLAs, designing graceful degradation, building observability, and leading incident response.

- Strong programming or scripting skills in a language such as Java, Kotlin, C++, Python or a similar language.

- A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

- Experience setting technical direction across multiple teams through design reviews, RFCs, and architecture decisions.

- Strong analytical skills, using operational and product data to guide technical decisions.

PREFERRED

- Experience in fintech, payments, or other regulated financial domains.

- Deep experience with JVM-based ecosystems, including Java or Kotlin with Spring or Spring Boot.

- Prior experience leading teams responsible for high-availability, low-latency systems.

YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

- You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

- You hold yourself to a high standard even when no one is watching. Quality and accountability aren't external expectations, they're internal ones.

- You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.

- You enjoy working closely with people across multiple countries and time zones as part of one connected, global team.

- You can advocate hard for a position, then fully support the team's direction once a call is made.

title: Staff Software Engineer, AI Gateway
description:
ABOUT DOCKER

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

Docker AI Gateway is our answer to the complexity of taking AI agents from prototype to production. It’s a powerful, intelligent, and secure control point that eliminates the toil of model orchestration, tool management, observability, and governance - so developers can focus on building incredible AI agents, not gluing together infrastructure.

The Gateway sits at the center of modern AI applications, offering:

- A model and tool routing layer with built-in security and cost optimization

- A familiar OpenAI-compatible interface and MCP server

- Unified observability and policy enforcement

- Auto-RAG, tool injection, session summarization, and more

We’re just getting started and we need exceptional engineers to help us build the backbone of the future of agent-based development.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Set technical direction for core systems powering the AI Gateway 0 the model router, MCP gateway, and control plane - and make sure architectural decisions hold up as usage scales by 10x

- Consistently identify gaps in our infrastructure, process, or tooling before they become blockers, and drive the fix from idea to production

- Take a significant, hands-on role in defining, delivering, and implementing the Gateway's technical strategy, in close partnership with engineering leadership

- Own the hardest, highest-ambiguity problems in the system: dynamic model selection, auto-failover, cost-based routing, and policy enforcement that has to work end-to-end

- Act as the go-to expert for secure credential storage, session summarization, caching, and rate limiting - the capabilities everything else depends on

- Build the infrastructure that lets us, and our customers, evaluate, replay, and backtest agent and LLM behavior with confidence

- Mentor senior and mid-level engineers, and raise the technical bar for the team through code, design review, and example

- Partner with product, design, and leadership to shape not just what the control plane UI does, but where the product goes next

KEY PROBLEMS YOU’LL HELP SOLVE
